summary: Fixed Bin-wise option exposed for Store clients (Problem 1) and empty Article-wise report for barcode-wise/Store sessions (Problem 2)

problem_1.user_report: Store clients should NOT see Bin-wise variance option when creating a session — stores are audited barcode-wise directly.
problem_1.fix: PortalSessions.jsx: on client_id change, when selected client.client_type === 'store', auto-set variance_mode='barcode-wise'. Variance Mode dropdown now (a) hides the bin-wise option entirely, (b) is disabled, (c) shows helper 'Store clients are audited barcode-wise only (no bin/location tracking).' Warehouse clients keep both options unchanged.
problem_1.verification: Playwright drove the New Session dialog: [STORE] options=[barcode-wise only], disabled=True, value=barcode-wise. [WAREHOUSE] options=[bin-wise, barcode-wise], disabled=False.

problem_2.user_report: Stock uploaded for Store client shows in Barcode-wise variance but NOT in Article-wise. (Category-wise reportedly also empty per user; backend data check showed Category-wise IS populated, but Article-wise was empty.)
problem_2.root_cause: audit_routes.py::get_article_wise_report had a filter `if e.get('location','') not in scanned_locations: continue` intended to make article totals match bin-wise totals for partially-scanned bin sessions. For barcode-wise sessions (Store clients) every expected stock row has location='' and synced_locations is empty until store is fully scanned — so the filter discarded all 13,743 rows, leaving the report empty.
problem_2.fix: Apply the scanned-location filter ONLY when session.variance_mode === 'bin-wise'. For barcode-wise (Store) and other modes, all expected rows are included — matching the behaviour of barcode-wise and category-summary reports.

lint_status: Frontend: clean. Backend: only pre-existing style warnings (E702 semicolons, F841 unused vars) — none introduced by this fix.
next_actions: User should hard-refresh the Reports page, open Nicobar Store -> Nicobar session -> Article-wise tab to confirm 13,719 articles now visible.
